annotations.title: Keep a site out of the portfolio

description: For the owner of a site: takes it out of every portfolio but their own, at once, or with out false puts it back. Needs the site proved with this key by DNS or a file. To keep a site in portfolios but take its name off, call mttr_list with show false.

out.description: True to take it out, false to put it back. True if left out.

site.description: The site, as a domain such as example.com.
